description: The workspace's web on Ploa's hosting (Ploa Aio), each the web app or site of one app: its address, what it is (a web app, pages about the app, or both; installable as a PWA), and its versions with where each stands (going up, with testers at its testing address, waiting for a person to approve its release, live, replaced), Ploa's checks on each, and the hosting room. Read-only. Start here.

site.description: The site's address (the part before .ploa.app) or ID. Needed when the workspace has more than one site.
